provenance.captureRule: Record the exact then-current validated release-source SHA and signed-candidate artifact SHA-256 with every final screenshot. Do not repin this plan solely because documentation-only release-source SHAs advance.

story.title: Secure Welcome
story.state: Authorized employee welcome / trusted-device enrollment entry state without revealing a token, QR secret, recovery value, email address, or real employee identity.
story.altText: Paradise Performance secure employee welcome and trusted-device access screen.

story.title: Performance Today
story.state: Idle/current-workday state before Start My Day, using synthetic employee identity and no production KPI/pay values.
story.altText: Paradise Performance Today screen before the employee starts the workday.

story.title: Start My Day
story.state: Employee-started active-workday flow showing the user action that begins the controlled workday/location function; do not expose exact real coordinates or a real route.
story.altText: Paradise Performance employee-started Start My Day workday flow.

story.title: Field Lookup
story.state: Lookup field/legal instruction view using non-sensitive controlled jurisdiction content and no customer information.
story.altText: Paradise Performance field lookup screen with controlled operating guidance.

story.title: Paradise University
story.state: Training/progress view using synthetic progress state and currently enabled training content only.
story.altText: Paradise University training and progress screen inside Paradise Performance.

story.title: Finish Day
story.state: Completed-workday / Finish Day state from the same final signed binary, with synthetic workday values and no real route or employee data.
story.altText: Paradise Performance completed workday and Finish Day screen.

forbiddenScreenshotContent: real customer names, addresses, phone numbers or appointments
real employee names, emails, IDs, routes or precise locations
enrollment QR codes, one-time tokens, passwords, recovery values or signing credentials
customer SET or Quick Set surfaces not enabled in store v1
KPI pace labels, pay amounts, compensation rules or leaderboard surfaces not enabled in store v1
route-map surfaces unless enabled in the exact submitted binary
store ranking, award, price or download claims
device frames or marketing overlays in the controlled base capture
preCaptureReadback: exact signed binary version/build/bundle ID matches controlled release
exact current validated release-source SHA and signed-candidate artifact SHA-256 are recorded
iOS build metadata reports iPhone device family only
approved Paradise icon is present in the signed binary
synthetic review account is active and contains no production data
all six states are reachable in the exact submitted binary
screen contains no notifications, carrier/provider text requiring cleanup, or unrelated personal data
postCaptureQc: pixel dimensions and file format match platform target
no stretching, distortion or invented UI
visual sequence tells the same six-state story on both platforms where the UI is equivalent
every screenshot is visually compared to the exact signed candidate UI
SHA-256, exact signed-candidate artifact SHA-256 and exact validated release-source SHA at capture time are recorded for each final screenshot
